description: Full catalogue entry for one agent: metadata, element types, availability and deployment state, and whether it is blocked. The raw body is returned alongside the mapped fields, because the detail resource carries more than the list rows. Read-only (cs_login scope 'graph'). Needs a Microsoft Agent 365 licence and is global-cloud only. Unverified against a live tenant.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

id.description: Package id from cs_list_org_agents, e.g. P_19ae1zz1-56bc-505a-3d42-156df75a4xxy

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

version.description: Graph version for reads. Default v1.0; beta may carry fields v1.0 does not.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_get_org_agent
title: Read one agent from the Microsoft 365 catalogue
